name: beautiful-frontend
title_zh: 先定视觉方向再写代码的前端设计把关员
tagline_zh: 受够了AI生成的千篇一律页面？它强制你做出艺术指导级的设计决策，用具体字体和排版取代自动填充套路，让落地页。
tagline_en: Tired of generic AI pages? It forces a committed visual direction before code, replacing autopilot with concrete.
desc_en: This skill should be loaded whenever the agent is about to write browser-rendered visual output — landing/marketing/pricing pages, dashboards, product UI, clickable prototypes, or visual additions to an existing site — and the bar is work that looks art-directed rather than AI-generated. It forces a committed art direction before any code and replaces autopilot patterns with concrete typographic,
why_zh: 机制上先锁死艺术方向再动手，从源头掐断AI默认样式；把版式、字体落到具体选择，而非空泛的“现代感”。
why_en: Locks art direction first, killing default AI styles at the root; turns vague 'modern' into specific typography and layout.
limit_zh: 只作用于浏览器渲染的视觉输出（落地页/仪表盘/原型）；不处理后端逻辑或交互状态；需要你配合提供设计偏好。
limit_en: Only for browser-rendered visual output (pages/dashboards/prototypes); no backend or state logic; needs your design input or it stops to ask.
